decision.reason: [ev-9c5e6c5bc8ee] only says that support for a "customized zipkin collector endpoint" was added. It does not name the configuration surface (MeshConfig/extensionProviders field, Helm value, CRD field or env var), the field name or path, or a default value, so the subject cannot be typed. Without that, applicability cannot be written either. The rest of the telemetry section ([ev-f1e311e8bf49] and the others) covers unrelated changes and adds nothing concrete about this one. To decide, we need the PR behind note 53086 or the API/docs change that names the new field.
